description: Your default settings. New projects start with them; a project can change them for itself with `PATCH /v1/projects/{id}`.

insightsModelType.description: Provider type of the model: `GPT` for the GPT models, `CUSTOM` for `plai` and `aita`. It follows from the model.

insightsModelName.description: Model that writes summaries and insights: `gpt-5-mini` or `gpt-4o-mini`.

translationModelType.description: Provider type of the model: `GPT` for the GPT models, `CUSTOM` for `plai` and `aita`. It follows from the model.

translationModelName.description: Model that translates: `aita` (AI Translation Agent), `plai` (Phrase Language AI), `gpt-5-mini` or `gpt-4o-mini`.

mtProfileId.description: Phrase TMS machine translation profile uid. Only `plai` and `aita` use one; an empty string means none is set.

translationMemoryId.description: Phrase TMS translation memory uid. Only `plai` and `aita` use one; an empty string means none is set.

ttsProvider.description: Text-to-speech engine that new projects dub with. Some engines are switched on or off per organization: `GET /v1/tts/engines` lists the ones you can use, and an engine that is not available to your organization is refused with `400`.
